description: Optimization of Water Distribution of Network Systems Using the Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm (Case study: Homashahr City) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Saeid Akbarifard. In this dataset applies the Harris Hawks Optimization Algorithm for optimization of the water distribution network of the Homashahr located in Iran for a period of one month (from 30 September 2018 to 30 October 2019). The utilized time-series data included water demand, reservoir storage. Coverage: national (IR); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
